key_risks: Personal guarantee is limited to £300,000, covering only 25% of the loan amount, leaving the bank exposed to the remaining £900,000 if the borrower defaults and the collateral is insufficient.
Security is limited to a single first legal charge over the freehold factory, creating concentration risk should the property value decline or be insufficient to cover the loan.
mitigants: LTV of 64.9% provides comfortable headroom below the 75% policy limit.
DSCR of 1.65 exceeds the minimum 1.25x requirement, indicating strong cash‑flow coverage.
Net debt/EBITDA of 1.9 is well within the 3.5x ceiling, showing a healthy leverage profile.
Twelve years of trading history demonstrates established operating performance.
Financial covenants (minimum DSCR 1.25x, maximum net debt/EBITDA 3.0x) are documented and stricter than policy thresholds, offering ongoing monitoring.
KYC is complete and audited accounts have been provided, confirming the borrower’s financial reporting integrity.
risk.summary: Harbourside Precision Engineering Ltd presents a low‑risk profile with strong cash‑flow coverage (DSCR 1.65), modest leverage (net debt/EBITDA 1.9) and ample LTV headroom (64.9%). The borrower has a solid 12‑year trading history, complete KYC, audited accounts and robust financial covenants that exceed policy minima. Residual risks stem from a partial personal guarantee (£300k) and reliance on a single property charge, but these are mitigated by the substantial security cushion and covenant framework. Overall, the deal meets all policy thresholds and warrants approval.
